description: A researched buying guide (koopwijzer) for a kind of product, e.g. 'airfryer': the models compared (key specs, today's lowest promotion), what each feature does, when you need it and when not, and general facts, every statement with its source. Use it for 'best <product>' and 'which <product> should I buy' questions ('beste airfryer', 'welke wasmachine kopen'): it does not crown a winner, it gives the cited test and buyer scores with their sources. Without a type: the list of guides.

type.description: Kind of product, Dutch or English, e.g. 'airfryer', 'heteluchtfriteuse'. Optional.

name: get_buying_guide
